scope: Independent engineering review of queryable host recording outcomes; no behavioral or paid model evaluation

native_windows.scope: Host-outcome unit and adapter checks plus three independent proxy/erasure cases. Four database/service cases and the Linux-specific fd fault injection were deliberately not selected.

wsl_independent.scope: Immutable runtime snapshot; failed rollback and later confirmation, erased-target isolation, read-only proxy queries across restart and identities, and another owner callback preserved during erase.

resolved_findings: Ambiguous queue admission was reported as definite failure and could not be refined by replay.
Erased exchange metadata bypassed recording-target isolation.
Erasing one owner removed another owner unmatched callbacks from the same session.
prior_results: Snapshot-1 proxy probe failed because that early snapshot predated proxy integration; retained as an early-candidate result, not a finished-candidate defect.
An initial same-profile probe lacked contract/migration assets in its review snapshot. The harness was completed with unchanged baseline assets and the profile identity check passed.
integration_condition: Match the final runtime build ID and complete package, live-host and required CI checks before merging.
